blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-attention carries a quadratic cost in token count, which limits how far Vision Transformers can scale with input resolution. We introduce SSoG, a separable sum-of-Gaussians spatial operator that replaces dense self-attention with a learned mixture of axis-factorized Gaussian kernels, reducing the per-layer cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to subquadratic in $N$. Unlike dot-product self-attention, whose Lipschitz constant is unbounded outside a compact input domain, SSoG with fixed kernels is globally Lipschitz continuous, which, via the Picard--Lindelöf theorem, guarantees that the continuous-depth variant has a unique solution on the whole integration interval, a global guarantee that dense-attention counterparts lack in general. On CIFAR-100 at $224\times224$, in a matched discrete-Transformer setting and in the continuous setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 2.2--4.1 points across three model widths while using 8.8--16.6\% fewer parameters, with depth and training recipe held fixed. In a looped-Transformer setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 5.4--8.1 points. We further probe inference-time scaling by evaluating on inputs up to $1024\times1024$ at matched batch size: in the continuous-depth (Neural ODE) architecture, SSoG reaches up to 154\% higher throughput and over 60\% lower peak memory than dense attention, with the gap widening as resolution grows, consistent with the difference in asymptotic cost. In the discrete and looped settings, SSoG also achieves over 30\% higher throughput than dense attention at this resolution. Together, these results establish SSoG as a practical, parameter-efficient, and theoretically grounded alternative to dense attention across discrete, weight-shared, and continuous-depth Transformer variants.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The self-attention mechanism, implemented through scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) Vaswani et al. (2017) , has marked a paradigm shift in AI. ViT Dosovitskiy et al. (2021) showed that this SDPA mechanism could scale to images, and this led to remarkably impressive results across a wide range of vision tasks. Foundation models such as DINO Caron et al. (2021) , SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) for segmentation and DiT Peebles & Xie (2023) for diffusion, as well as VLMs and LLMs, demonstrated that this attention mechanism could scale to results beyond what seemed possible. Alongside these strengths, however, come several problems: the complexity of self-attention itself, a limited understanding of how a model learns to attend , difficulty training these models due to theoretical issues inherent to SDPA, and the emergence of artifacts Darcet et al. (2024) ; Qiu et al. (2025) , among others. These issues have mostly been studied in isolation. In this paper, we show that reducing the complexity of self-attention and satisfying the theoretical property required for Lipschitz continuity can be achieved by the same operator, and we study the behaviour of this operator when instantiated across discrete, looped, and continuous-depth Transformers.
blocks.zh: 通过大规模点产品关注(SDPA) Vaswani等人(2017年)实施的自我关注机制标志着AI的范式转变. ViT Dosovitskiy等人(2021年)表明,这种SDPA机制可以被放大到图像上,这在一系列广泛的愿景任务中产生了令人印象深刻的结果。 DINO Caron等人(2021年)、SAM Kirillov等人(2023年)等基础模型以及用于传播的DiT Peebles & Xie(2023年),以及VLMs和LLMs,都表明这种关注机制可以超越似乎可能的结果。 然而,除了这些长处之外,还出现了几个问题:自我关注本身的复杂性、对模型如何学习参与的理解有限、由于SDPA固有的理论问题而难以培训这些模型、以及出品达克特等(2024年)、邱等(2025年)等等。 这些问题大多被孤立地研究. 在本文中,我们表明降低自我关注的复杂性并满足利普希茨连续性所需的理论属性可以由同一位操作员实现,我们研究这个操作员在通过离散的,循环的,连续的深度变形器进行即时切入时的行为.

blocks.en: The complexity of SDPA arises from the token sequence length. For N N tokens of dimension d d , SDPA needs 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) memory and 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ​ d ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}d) computation, and in vision N N grows with the square of the image side, so the cost increases with the resolution. Research on context compression Zhang et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) reduces the memory needed to store the matrix, reducing the effective sequence length, but the operation is still quadratic. State Space Models Gu & Dao (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2024) drop pairwise interaction altogether and are linear in N N ; however, they tend to be harder to train and imply a complete change of architecture. Looped Transformers Byra et al. (2026) and Neural ODEs Zhong et al. (2022) work on a different axis: they share parameters across depth, which reduces model size but not the cost of a single evaluation. Moreover, these models are sensitive to hyperparameters, and noise in the parameter space is carried through all the optimization steps and cannot be isolated.

(2026)减少了存储矩阵所需的内存,减少了有效的序列长度,但操作仍然为四相. 州航天模型Gu & Dao (2024); Zhu等人 (2024) 完全抛出双相交互,在N N 中呈线性;然而,它们往往更难训练并意味着结构的彻底改变. Looped Transformers Byra等 (2026)和Neural CODEs Zhong等 (2022)在不同的轴上工作:它们共享了跨深度的参数,这减少了模型大小,但没有降低单一评价的成本. 此外,这些模型对超参数计很敏感,参数空间中的噪声会通过所有优化步骤来传递,不能被隔离.

blocks.en: Beyond the cost of recurrent and continuous models, they inherit a second, more fundamental problem from dense attention itself: attention scores are computed over an unbounded domain. Since the query-key interaction is an inner product between unconstrained vectors, SDPA is not globally Lipschitz continuous Kim et al. (2021) . This is part of why the literature argues that Transformers are sensitive to hyperparameters, initialization, and learning rate Qi et al. (2023) . These theoretical implications matter most for continuous-depth models. Dense attention is smooth, and hence Lipschitz on bounded sets, so the Picard–Lindelöf theorem still guarantees a unique solution locally in time. What global Lipschitz continuity adds is existence of the solution on the whole integration interval for every initial condition, without finite-time blow-up, together with a uniform bound on how much two trajectories can drift apart when their initial conditions differ. Recurrent and continuous architectures, which apply the same block many times, are therefore the ones that benefit most from a property that dense attention lacks.
blocks.zh: 除了经常和连续模式的成本外,它们还继承了密集关注本身产生的第二个、更根本的问题:注意力的分数是在一个没有界限的领域计算的。 由于查询-键交互是不受约束向量之间的内出产,SDPA并不是全球Lipschitz continual Kim等 (2021). 因此,文献认为"变形"对超参数,初始化,和学习率Qi等敏感(2023年). 这些理论影响对于持续深入的模型最为重要. 因此,Picard-Lindelöf定理仍然保证当地及时找到独特的解决方案。 全球Lipschitz连续性所补充的是,每个初始条件的整个集成间隔上都存在溶液,没有有时间限制的爆炸时间,同时统一约束两种轨迹在初始条件不同时可以漂移多少. 因此,经常和连续的建筑多次适用同一块块,最能受益于密集的注意力所缺乏的财产。

blocks.en:
Pisoni (2026) recently outlined SSoG, a Sum of Separable Gaussians operator that replaces dot-product attention in standard ViTs with a small mixture of anisotropic, axis-factorized Gaussian kernels, in a fixed and a content-steered variant, and reported preliminary results on image classification. Because the kernel factorizes along the image axes, SSoG never builds the N × N N\times N attention matrix and is subquadratic in N N . We study it in a regime for which it was neither designed nor analyzed: as the token mixer of looped and continuous-depth Transformers.
 In this paper, we show that SSoG with fixed kernels is globally Lipschitz continuous by construction, precisely the property that looped and continuous-depth models require, while its content-steered variant is Lipschitz on sets of bounded token norms; we are the first to study it inside these architectures. Unlike MHA, where tokens compete for a fixed normalization budget through content-dependent scores, fixed SSoG assigns weights from a spatial kernel of the relative offsets, so no token can take mass away from another, leaving no mechanism for an attention sink to form. We confirm this empirically on the trained models: dense attention develops a persistent sink on ImageNet, whereas SSoG does not (Appendix A.2 ). We benchmark this instantiation of SSoG against dense attention across discrete, looped, and continuous-depth settings, providing the first empirical and theoretical characterization of its behavior as a weight-shared, continuous-depth attention mechanism. We also find that content steering improves the discrete and looped models but not the continuous-depth one, and that the efficiency gains of SSoG grow with input resolution.

Pisoni (2026)最近概述了SSOG,一个Sum of Separable Gaussians操作器,该操作器在标准ViTs中将点产品注意取而代之的是由同位素,轴构型的高斯内核组成的小混合物,在一个固定和内容被扭曲的变体中,并报告了图像分类的初步结果. 由于内核会沿图像轴进行因子化,SSOG从未构建出N×N\times N的注意力矩阵,并在N N中为亚水分. 我们把它放在一个既非设计也非分析的制度中来研究:它是循环和不断深入的变形器的象征性混合器。
在本文中,我们显示有固定内核的SSOG通过构建是全球连续的,正是循环和连续深入模型所需要的属性,而其内容被精选的变体是Lipschitz在几套有约束的符号规范上;我们是第一个在这些架构内对其进行研究的. 与MHA不同的是,信使通过依赖内容的分数来竞争固定正常化预算,而固定的SSoG则从相对相抵的空间内核中分配权重,因此任何信使都不能从另一个信使中带走质量,使注意力沉没的机制无法形成. 我们从经验上在训练有素的模型上证实了这一点:密集的注意力在ImageNet上发展出一个持久的汇,而SSoG则没有(附录A.2 )。 我们以SSOG的即兴反应为基准, 以分散的、循环的和连续的深度环境的密集关注为基准, 提供了第一个经验性和理论性特征, 来描述它的行为, 是一种权重共享的、连续的深度关注机制。 我们还发现,内容引导改进了离散和循环的模式,而不是持续深入的模式,而且SSoG的效率收益随着输入分辨率的增长而增加。

blocks.en: • We prove that fixed SSoG is globally Lipschitz by construction, which makes continuous-depth models built on it well posed on the whole integration interval, and that the content-steered variant is Lipschitz on bounded sets (Appendix A.6 ). • We use SSoG, in fixed and content-steered variants, as a drop-in replacement for dense attention in discrete, looped and continuous-depth vision Transformers, and benchmark it extensively against dense attention in each setting. • We study the accuracy-compute trade-off of ODE-SSoG in integration depth and number of atoms, and show its sub-quadratic operator gains over dense attention in throughput and memory as resolution grows.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work & Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作和讨论

blocks.en: Most work on subquadratic attention approximates the softmax kernel instead of abandoning it, using low-rank projections, random features or kernel feature maps Wang et al. (2020) ; Choromanski et al. (2021) ; Katharopoulos et al. (2020) . What ties these together is the idea that attention acts as a kernel smoother Tsai et al. (2019) , which vision models have since adopted in several forms Han et al. (2023) ; Cai et al. (2023) . SSoG goes the other way: it fixes the form of the kernel in advance and learns only the geometry, so the saving comes from structure and not from an approximation. Computationally the closest relatives are separable large-kernel convolutions Guo et al. (2023) ; Lau et al. (2024) , which split a two-dimensional depthwise kernel into cascaded one-dimensional ones for the same reason we do. What we do differently is constrain each axis kernel to a mixture of R R Gaussians instead of learning a free weight at every tap, and that constraint turns out to cost little, since accuracy can be saturated at few atoms per head: for instance, the continuous model with eight atoms uses an effective number of only 3.381 3.381 .
blocks.zh: 大部分关于亚夸德拉克注意力的作品相近于软马克斯内核而不是放弃它,使用低等的预测,随机特征或内核特征地图Wang等 (2020).; Choromanski等 (2021); Katharopoulos等 (2020). 将这些问题联系在一起的,是关注作为内核平滑剂的Tsai等人(2019年)的想法,从那时起,视觉模型已经以多种形式采用Han等人(2023年);Cai等人(2023年)。 SSOG走出另一条路:它事先固定了内核的形式,只学习几何,所以保存来自结构而不是近似. 推算出最相近的亲缘关系是可分离出的大内核演化出郭等(2023年);刘等(2024年),由于我们这样做的同样原因,将一个二维深度内核分解出一维级. 我们所做的不同是将每个轴内核限制在R高斯核的混合上,而不是在每一个水龙头上学习一个自由的重量,而这种限制结果是成本很少的,因为精确度可以在每头几个原子上被饱和:例如,有8个原子的连续模型使用的有效数字只有3.381 3.381。

blocks.en: Gaussians appear often as a spatial prior for attention. The attention maps of a trained ViT tend towards a Gaussian shape Kim et al. (2023) , and several models add a learned Gaussian term to the attention logits Hajimiri et al. (2026) , which keeps the N × N N\times N matrix and makes the Gaussian a bias on top of attention rather than the operator itself. Closer to how we parameterize things, Kundu et al. (2026) drop the query and key projections in favour of an RBF kernel with one bandwidth per head but still compare every pair of tokens, and concurrently Huang & Raza (2026) route tokens through Gaussian mixture components in a latent feature space for language. The operator we study is that of Pisoni (2026) , who proposed SSoG for standard ViTs; our contribution lies in its theoretical analysis and in its use as a weight-shared and continuous-depth token mixer. We place the Gaussians over the grid of tokens instead, which is what makes the factorization along axes possible, but it also limits how much content dependence the operator can take on. In the continuous-depth model, steering the width alone matches the fixed model ( 74.01 % 74.01\% against 74.22 % 74.22\% ) and steering the centers alone costs 0.77 0.77 points, while steering both drops to 71.21 % 71.21\% ; equation 2 suggests why: the center and the spread appear together as the ratio ( δ a − μ a ) 2 / 2 ​ σ a 2 (\delta_{a}-\mu_{a})^{2}/2\sigma_{a}^{2} , so when both depend on the query the numerator and the denominator can drift at the same time. We therefore recommend the fixed operator or a limited steering for this model, whereas full steering improves the discrete and looped models (Table 7 ).

Kim et al. (2021) showed that dot-product attention is not globally Lipschitz, and the work that followed recovers the property by constraining the operator after the fact, either by substituting Lipschitz counterparts for the unstable components Qi et al. (2023) or by normalizing the
layer and bounding its spectral norm Dasoulas et al. (2021) ; Yudin et al. (2025) . In fixed SSoG it comes out of the parameterization itself, because the mixing weights depend only on bounded geometric parameters and not on inner products between unconstrained token vectors, so nothing has to be added to the loss to obtain it (Proposition 1 ); the content-steered variant retains this property only on bounded sets (Proposition 2 ). This matters most when one block is applied many times, which covers both depth
recurrence, from the Universal Transformer Dehghani et al. (2019) and ALBERT Lan et al. (2020) to the fully shared single-block ViT of Byra et al. (2026) , and continuous depth, from Chen et al. (2018) to recent image classifiers Zhong et al. (2022) ; Sander et al. (2022) ; Boned Riera et al. (2025) ; Belhasin et al. (2026) . This second line has mostly used convolutional vector fields, which, unlike attention, are globally Lipschitz and thus satisfy the Picard–Lindelöf theorem on the whole interval.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that Lipschitz continuity contributes to the accuracy gains: our three settings differ in how much the property should matter, and the results are consistent with that order. The looped model applies an unconstrained dense block repeatedly and gains the most, 7.02 7.02 points on average and 79.80 % 79.80\% against 72.30 % 72.30\% at D = 768 D=768 . The discrete model never repeats a block and gains 3.66 3.66 points. ODE-ViT also repeats one block, but it already relaxes the requirement to a local bound, since the JaSMin loss of Boned Riera et al. (2025) penalizes the eigenvalue distribution of the attention map and constrains the spectral radius, which may explain why its gain of 3.32 3.32 points is closer to that of the discrete setting than to that of the looped one. The regularizer also has a computational cost. Regularizing the spectrum of the attention map requires materializing that matrix during training, which rules out a fused kernel and keeps the full N × N N\times N map in the computational graph at every function evaluation, so the memory and latency overhead grows with the NFE. What ODE-ViT obtains with a regularizer whose cost scales with the matrix it regularizes, fixed SSoG obtains from the form of the operator at no additional cost. Our efficiency benchmarks (§ 3.3 ) are measured at inference, where the regularizer is not evaluated; there, the advantage over ODE-ViT reflects the asymptotic cost of the operator together with the fact that the ODE-ViT baseline does not use a fused attention kernel (Appendix A.1.1 ).

The margins narrow on ImageNet, where SSoG is on par with its counterparts while requiring less compute and achieving higher throughput. Part of this is expected, since a fixed spatial prior is an inductive bias and inductive biases are worth less when data is
abundant. It also bounds what the Lipschitz argument can claim, because a benefit that shrinks with dataset size behaves like regularization rather than like well-posedness. We compare only against dense attention, while linear-attention variants and state space models Gu & Dao (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2024) scale subquadratically as well and are the natural competitors in the regime where SSoG wins. SSoG is also 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 3 / 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{3/2}) rather than linear (Appendix A.1 ), so a state space model keeps an asymptotic advantage, whereas SSoG drops into an existing model without changing the rest of the architecture or the training recipe. Finally, we evaluate classification only, leaving open other tasks that could benefit from this operator.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: We presented the first systematic study of SSoG, a separable sum-of-Gaussians alternative to dense self-attention recently outlined by Pisoni (2026) , as the token mixer of discrete, looped and continuous-depth Transformers. We proved that its fixed form is globally Lipschitz continuous, which guarantees a unique solution of the continuous-depth model on the whole integration interval, whereas the content-steered form is Lipschitz only on bounded sets; in both forms the cost is subquadratic in the number of tokens. On CIFAR-100, SSoG outperformed dense attention in all three settings with fewer parameters, most markedly in the looped one; on ImageNet-1k it matched or exceeded dense attention in the discrete and continuous-depth settings and trailed it slightly in the looped one. Its throughput advantage widened with resolution, and it used less memory than dense attention in the continuous-depth and discrete settings but not in the looped one, where the dense baseline benefits from a fused kernel. Future work includes a fused implementation of SSoG, tasks beyond classification, and a comparison with linear attention and state space models.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SSOG的第一次系统研究,这是皮索尼(2026年)最近概述的替代密集自觉的可分化的Gousisians的总和(2026年),作为离散,环绕和连续深度变形器的符号搅拌器. 我们证明了它的固定形式是全球的Lipschitz连续的,它保证了连续深入模型在整个集成间隔上的独特解决方案,而内容定型的Lipschitz只在被捆绑的组合上;在这两种形式中,成本在符号数量上都是次等价. 在CIFAR-100上,SSoG在所有三种设置中都超过了密集的注意,参数较少,最明显的是循环的;在ImageNet-1k上,它在离散和连续的深度设置中与密集的注意相匹配或超过密集的注意,并在循环的设置中稍有后退. 它的通量优势随着分辨率而扩大,在连续深入和离散的环境下,它使用的内存比密集的注意更少,但在循环的环境下却没有使用密集的基线,因为密集的基线从一个被熔化的内核中受益. 未来的工作包括SSOG的分解实施,超越分类的任务,以及与线性关注和状态空间模型的比较.

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en:
We release the complete source code as anonymized supplementary material. Every experiment is specified by a modular, hierarchical Hydra configuration: a base file per dataset and architecture setting (continuous, discrete and looped; SSoG and dense-attention baselines) fixes the full training recipe, and each experiment is a short file that inherits from it and overrides only the varied quantity (width, heads, atoms, depth or NFE, or augmentation), so every reported run corresponds to exactly one versioned configuration file. Each model family has its own entry point on a shared PyTorch Lightning training pipeline, and we provide the cluster launch scripts used for every run. Training is seeded through Lightning’s seed_everything (including data-loader workers) and run with deterministic=True ; the default seed is 42. Architectures and the training recipes are described in section 2 and section 3 , and the per-ablation settings in Appendix A.3 – A.5 .
Efficiency numbers come from a separate benchmark configuration and script, run on an NVIDIA A40 under torch.inference_mode() , with each model benchmarked in its own process (section 3.3 and Appendix A.1.1 ). We use only the public CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k datasets with their standard splits; all preprocessing and augmentation is defined in the released configurations and follows the DeiT recipe Touvron et al. (2021) . The table-generation and plotting scripts that produce every table and figure from the logged metrics are also included.

blocks.en: A.2 Attention sinks
blocks.zh: A.2 注意汇

blocks.en:
Dense attention can develop attention sinks : tokens that receive a
disproportionate share of attention from every query, largely independent of
the input. Fixed SSoG has no mechanism to form them. Its patch-to-patch
weights depend only on the relative offset between two patches, so every key
receives the same total attention up to renormalization at the image border,
and patches never attend to the class token, which only pools. Content
steering can move a kernel, but by at most α μ ​ M \alpha_{\mu}M tokens, so it
cannot concentrate attention from the whole image onto one token.

blocks.en:
We measure this on the trained models (Table 5 ). A
sink requires three things at once: a key that receives much more than
uniform attention ( sink score ), the same key across images
( same key : the share of images whose most-attended key is the head’s
most frequent one), and persistence across layers, which the residual
attention rollout captures because it compounds only concentration that the
heads and layers agree on.
blocks.zh:
我们用训练有素的模型来衡量这一点(表5)。 A级
shink 一次需要三样东西: 接收比
统一注意( sink 分数),图像的同键
(同一密钥:最受关注的密钥为头的相片份额)
和分层的持久性,剩余
注意的展开能捕捉到 因为它只使浓度增加
头和地层都同意

blocks.en:
Only the ImageNet dense model meets all three. In its worst layer the
most-attended key receives 40.6 × 40.6\times the uniform mass, it is the same token
in 91 % 91\% of images, and the rollout compounds it to 41.4 × 41.4\times ; 8.1 % 8.1\% of
patch attention also flows to the class token. The CIFAR-100 dense models each
fail at least one condition. The continuous one has strong single-head peaks
( 22.9 × 22.9\times in the worst layer), but the attended key changes from image to
image (same key in 6 % 6\% of images) and rollout washes it out ( 1.7 × 1.7\times ):
content-dependent focusing rather than a sink. The discrete one is
intermediate ( 8.1 × 8.1\times , same key in 49 % 49\% of images, 5.0 × 5.0\times under
rollout). The looped one has a higher same-key rate ( 64 % 64\% ) but a low
worst-layer score ( 3.5 × 3.5\times ), so consistency alone does not make a sink:
all three conditions must hold together.

最多看门的钥匙得到40.6×40.6\乘以统一质量,这是相同的
在91%的图像中,91%的图像,推出后将其复合为41.4×41.4\时; 8.1% 8.1%的图像

(22.9×22.9\时间在最糟糕的地层),但被参与的密钥从图像到
图像( 在图像的 6% 6% ) 中相同的密钥, 并推出 。 ( 1. 7 × 1. 7\ 时) :
内容依赖焦点而不是汇。 离散的那个
中间 (8.1 × 8.1\时, 相同键在49 % 49\ 图像中, 5.0 × 5.0\时)
(推出)。 循环键的同键率较高(64% 64\%),但较低

blocks.en:
Fixed SSoG stays at or below 3.3 × 3.3\times in every layer and 1.1 1.1 - 1.5 × 1.5\times under rollout in every setting. Its most-attended key is identical across
images ( 100 % 100\% ) only because its content-independent kernel always peaks at
an image corner through border renormalization, a geometric effect that no
input can move. Steering raises the worst-layer score moderately
( 5.3 × 5.3\times discrete, 2.9 × 2.9\times looped) and at the same time lowers the
same-key rate from 100 % 100\% to 60 % 60\% and 44 % 44\% , while rollout stays near
uniform ( 1.7 × 1.7\times and 1.6 × 1.6\times ). The added concentration therefore
follows the content, as in the continuous dense model, rather than forming a
fixed sink.

图像角通过边框再正常化, 几何效应为无
输入可以移动。 引导会中度提高最差的分数
( 5.3 × 5.3\时间离散, 2.9 × 2.9\时间被循环) 同时降低
同键率从100%-100%-60%-60%-60%-60%-和44%-44-%,而推出率则接近
制服(1.7×1.7\时间和1.6×1.6\时间)。 因此,增加的集中
遵循内容,如连续密集模型,而不是形成
固定水槽。

blocks.en:
SSoG does not, however, avoid feature-norm artifacts altogether. On ImageNet, 29 % 29\% of its final patch tokens have a norm above 3 × 3\times the image
median, against 3.5 % 3.5\% for the dense model. These tokens are concentrated at
the image border, which suggests a positional rather than content-driven
origin, unlike the isolated high-norm tokens associated with registers in
dense ViTs Darcet et al. (2024) . We therefore claim the absence of
attention sinks, not of norm artifacts.

Since sums and compositions of globally Lipschitz maps are globally Lipschitz, it suffices to bound each component. blocks.en: The preceding Remark has the same structure as the obstruction that Kim et al. (2021) identify for dot-product attention, namely a data-dependent mixing matrix multiplying a data-dependent value matrix, but not the same rate. Attention logits are inner products between two token features, so the Lipschitz constant of the mixing matrix itself grows with ‖ X ‖ \|X\| and the available upper bounds on a ball of radius ρ \rho grow as ρ 2 \rho^{2} ; the steered kernel depends only on the query token and only through a bounded tanh \tanh , so L 𝒜 h L^{h}_{\mathcal{A}} does not depend on X X and the bound of Proposition 2 grows as ρ \rho . Relative to dot-product attention, steering thus lowers the exponent of this bound from two to one, and the fixed variant removes the dependence on ρ \rho altogether. We therefore regard Proposition 1 as a further reason to prefer the fixed operator, alongside the accuracy results of § 3.2 .
